about.title: About the party
about.body: The Tamilaga Vazhvurimai Katchi is a regional political party in Tamil Nadu. It was founded in January 2012 by Mr. T. Velmurugan. The party works for Tamil identity, social justice, and the development of the state.
about.founderBody: Founder and leader of Tamizhaga Vazhvurimai Katchi. He has served as a Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly representing the Panruti constituency, and was previously associated with the Pattali Makkal Katchi before founding the party in 2012.

home.title: Join the movement. Carry your membership with pride.
home.subtitle: Enroll as a party member, get verified by the district office, and receive a digital membership card with a scannable verification code.

steps.title: How enrollment works
steps.oneBody: Fill in your details and upload a passport-size photo.
steps.twoBody: The party office reviews and approves your application.
steps.threeBody: A unique CRF number is issued and your card becomes downloadable.

enroll.title: Membership Enrollment
enroll.subtitle: All fields are required. Your details are kept private and reviewed by the party office.
enroll.photoHint: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB
enroll.successBody: Your application is pending review by the party office. You will receive your CRF number and membership card once approved.
